statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Continuous rhythm monitoring is clinically necessary to evaluate cardiac events and guide management
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
